[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Jonet Glasgow was born in 1622. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1030|Jhone Glasgow]] and [[Mathie-159|Jonat Mathei]].<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-7866956/jonet-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms. Christening: 26 Sep 1622 at High Church, Glasgow, Lanark, Scotland. Parents: Johne Glasgow and Jonet Mathie.</ref> She was baptismed 26 Sep 1622 at High Church, Glasgow, Lanarkshire.<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-7866956/jonet-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
She cannot be spouse of George Logan in 1628, if she was baptized 1622
*Jonet is possibly the same woman recorded as the spouse of George Logan in Steinstoun on 2 September 1628.

Not to be confused with [[Glasgow-3061|Jonet Glasgow (abt.1607-)]].

A possible identification concerns Joannet Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Joannet Glasgow and Andrew Allexander/ on 8 August 1661 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 230; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
